label: Ask me before an agent sends a message
hint: Holds each message an agent sends until you approve it in the thread.

label: Send copied text
hint: Change the shortcut that opens the list to send what you copied

label: Check for updates automatically
hint: Checks once a day while the companion runs. Check for updates works either way.

label: Check for updates
hint: Looks for a newer release. When one is known, updates the app and its command line tool, then restarts it.

label: Hide Agnostic AI companion
hint: Takes the circle and the list off the screen. The shortcut brings them back. The circle comes back faded on its own when something new waits.

label: Quit Agnostic AI companion
hint: Asks first, then ends the program. The shortcut stops working until you start it again with agnostic-ai companion.
